positive: Only assign positive when a direct seller-specific anchor is present, such as shared contact, shared PGP, or another stable identity marker.
Do not promote a whole graph component just because one edge has an anchor.
negative: Template clone, repeated product copy, public resource-package text, or shared topic evidence alone is not enough for a same-controller label.
Use negative only when the row has no seller-specific anchor and the business evidence supports seller-distinct template reuse.
uncertain: Use uncertain for dense template overlap without contact or PGP evidence.
Use uncertain when a cluster contains a real anchor core but the queued edge is part of a semantic or template expansion.
